lines.coptic: Ⲧⲉⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ϩⲓⲕⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉⲑⲙⲉϩ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ.

translations.english: You are more worthy, than all of the saints, to ask on our behalf, O full of grace.
translations.arabic: أنتِ مستحقة، أكثر من جميع القديسين، أن تطلبي عنا، أيتها الممتلئة نعمة.

transliterations.english: Teoi enhikanos: ehote nee-ethowab teerou: ethretovh egon: o thee-ethmeh enehmot.

sung.english: Tenth Part You are more worthy, than all of the saints, to pray on our behalf, O full of grace.

lines.coptic: Ⲧⲉϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ.

translations.english: You are exalted, more than the patriarchs, and honored more, than the prophets.
translations.arabic: أنتِ مرتفعة جداً، أكثر من رؤساء الآباء، ومكرمة أفضل، من الأنبياء.

transliterations.english: Techosi emasho: ehote nipatriarshees: o-woh tetaieeout: ehote ni-eprofeetees.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲧⲉ ϫⲓⲛⲙⲟϣⲓ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲡⲁⲣⲣⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ.

translations.english: And you have a seeking, more special, than the Cherubim, and the Seraphim.
translations.arabic: ولك سعيً، بدالة، أكثر من الشاروبيم، والسيرافيم.

transliterations.english: O-on te jinmoshi: khen ouparreesia: ehote Nisherouvim: nem Niserafim.

lines.coptic: Ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ.

translations.english: For you are truly, the pride of our race, and the intercessor, of our souls.
translations.arabic: لأنكِ أنتِ بالحقيقة، فخر جنسنا، وشفيعة، نفوسنا.

transliterations.english: Entho ghar aleethos: pe epshoushou empengenos: o-woh ti-eprostatees: ente nenpsishee.

lines.coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ϩⲟⲡⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁϫⲣⲟⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲛⲁϩϯ ⲉⲧⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ.

translations.english: Intercede for us, before our Savior, that He may keep us firm, in the upright faith.
translations.arabic: إشفعي فينا، أمام مخلصنا، لكي يثبتنا، في الإيمان المستقيم.

transliterations.english: Ari-epresvevin egon: nahren Pensoteer: hopos enteftagron: khen pinahti etsouton.

lines.coptic: Ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛϣⲁϣⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲛⲁⲓ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ.

translations.english: That He may grant us, the forgiveness of our sins, in order to win mercy, through your intercessions.
translations.arabic: وينعم لنا، بمغفرة خطايانا، لنفوز برحمةٍ، بشفاعاتِك.

transliterations.english: Enteferehmot nan: empiko evol ente nennovi: entenshashni evnai: hiten ne-epresvia.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲙⲁϩⲙⲏⲧⲟⲩⲓ̀:

translations.english: The Eleventh Part:
translations.arabic: القطعة الحادية عشر:

transliterations.english: Timahmeetoui:

sung.english: Eleventh Part

lines.coptic: Ⲣⲁⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲥⲱⲙⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲛϣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ.

translations.english: All the high names, of the incorporeal, thousands of angels, and archangels.
translations.arabic: كل الأسماء العالية، التي لغير المتجسدين، ألوف الملائكة، ورؤساء الملائكة.

transliterations.english: Ran niven etchosi: ente ni-asomatos: ni-anansho enangelos: nem arsheeangelos.

lines.coptic: Ⲙ̀ⲡⲟϣ̀ⲫⲟϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϭⲓⲥⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉⲧϫⲟⲗϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲥⲁⲃⲁⲱⲑ.

translations.english: They did not attain, your high blessedness, O who is clothed in, the glory of the Lord of hosts.
translations.arabic: لم يبلغوا، عظمة طوباوياتِك، أيتها المشتملة، بمجد رب الجنود.

transliterations.english: Empo-eshfoh e-epchisi: ente nemakarismos: o thee-etgolh empi-oou: ente Epshois savaoth.

lines.coptic: Ⲧⲉϩⲓⲁⲕⲧⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏ: ⲧⲉⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲗⲁⲙⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ.

translations.english: You are more brighter, than the sun, and more sparkling, than the Cherubim.
translations.arabic: أنتِ مضيئة، أكثر من الشمس، ولامعة أكثر، من الشاروبيم.

transliterations.english: Tehiaktin evol: ehote efree: teoi enlamepros: ehote Nisherouvim.

sung.english: You are brighter, than the sun, and more sparkling, than the Cherubim.

lines.coptic: Ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ: ⲛⲁ ⲡⲓⲥⲟⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩ: ⲥⲉⲉⲣⲣⲓⲡⲓⲍⲓⲛ ϧⲁϫⲱ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ϣ̀ⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀.

translations.english: And the Seraphim, with the six wings, which are joyfully, hovering over you.
translations.arabic: والسيرافيم، ذوى الستة الأجنحة، يرفرف عليكِ، بتهليل.

transliterations.english: Nem Niserafim: na pisoou entenh: se-erripizin khago: khen o-e-eshleeloui.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲙⲁϩⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ:

translations.english: The Twelfth Part:
translations.arabic: القطعة الثانية عشر:

transliterations.english: Timahmeetesnoti:

sung.english: Twelfth Part Your

lines.coptic: Ⲡⲉⲱ̀ⲟⲩ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ.

translations.english: Your glory O Mary, is higher than the heaven, you are more honored than the earth, and its inhabitants.
translations.arabic: مجدِك يا مريم، أرفع من السماء، وأنت أكرم من الأرض، وسكانها.

transliterations.english: Pe-oou Maria: chosi ehote etfe: tetaieeout e-epkahi: nem nee-etshop enkheetf.

sung.english: glory O Mary, is higher than heaven, you are more honored than the earth, and its inhabitants.

lines.coptic: Ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲧⲉ ϯⲥ̀ⲧⲣⲁⲧⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲉⲧⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲙ̀ⲙⲟϣⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀.

translations.english: For you are truly, the real path, leading up, to the heavens.
translations.arabic: لأنكِ أنتِ بالحقيقة، الطريق الحقيقي، المؤدي، إلى السموات.

transliterations.english: Entho ghar aleethos: te ti-estrata emmee: etoi emma-emmoshi: e-epshoi enifeeoui.

lines.coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϯϩⲓⲱϯ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲙⲟⲣϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϫⲟⲙ: ⲱ̀ ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ.

translations.english: You are clothed, with joy and gladness, and girdled with power, O daughter of Zion.
translations.arabic: لبسِت الفرح، والتهليل، وتمنطقتِ بالقوة، يا إبنة صهيون.

transliterations.english: Aretihioti: emefrashi nem eptheleel: aremorti enougom: o etsheri ension.

lines.coptic: Ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥϯϩⲓⲱⲧⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϩⲉⲃⲥⲱ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲥϩⲱⲃⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ: ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϩⲉⲃⲥⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ.

translations.english: O who was clothed, with the garments of the heavenly, so that you covered Adam, with the garments of grace.
translations.arabic: يا مَنْ لبسِت، لباس السمائيين، حتى سترتِ آدم، بلباس النعمة.

transliterations.english: O thee-etastihiots: enethevso enna nifeeoui: sha enteshovs enadam: enethevso empi-ehmot.

lines.coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟϥ ⲛ̀ⲕⲉⲥⲟⲡ: ⲉ̀Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲓⲥⲟⲥ: ⲡ̀ⲧⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ: ⲫ̀ⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ.

translations.english: And restored him again, to the Paradise, the rejoicing place, and dwelling of the righteous.
translations.arabic: ورددته مرة أخري، إلى الفردوس، موضع الفرح، ومسكن الصديقين.

transliterations.english: Aretastof enkesop: epiparathisos: eptopos emepounof: efma enshopi ennithikeos.

sung.english: And restored him, to Paradise, the place of joy, and the dwelling of the righteous.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲙⲁϩⲙⲏⲧϣⲟⲙϯ:

translations.english: The Thirteenth Part:
translations.arabic: القطعة الثالثة عشر:

transliterations.english: Timahmeetshomti:

sung.english: Thirteenth Part

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲧⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉⲩⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲙⲏϯ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲧⲙⲉⲑⲣⲉⲩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ.

translations.english: A true tabernacle, is Mary the Virgin, placed in its midst, the true testimonies.
translations.arabic: قبة حقيقية، هي مريم العذراء، موضوع في وسطها، الشهادات الصادقة.

transliterations.english: Ou-eskeenee emmee: te Maria Tiparthenos: evkee khen tesmeeti: enje nimetmethrev etenhot.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲕⲓⲃⲱⲧⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲑⲱⲗⲉⲃ: ⲉⲧⲟϣϫ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲥⲁ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲓ̀ⲗⲁⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙⲓⲕⲟⲛ.

translations.english: The undefiled ark, overlaid roundabout with gold, and the mercy seat, of the Cherubim.
translations.arabic: التابوت الغير الدنس، المصَّفح بالذهب، من كل ناحية، والغطاء الكاروبي.

transliterations.english: Tikivotos enattholeb: etoshg ennoub ensasa niven: nem pilasteerion: ensherouvimikon.

lines.coptic: Ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲙⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲛⲁ ϩⲏⲡ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ: ⲓⲥ Ⲡⲓⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ: ⲓ̀ ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲛ̀ϧⲏϯ.

translations.english: The golden vessel, where the manna was hidden, behold the Word of the Father, came and took flesh from you.
translations.arabic: القسط الذهبي، المخفي فيه المَنَّ، هوذا كلمة الآب، أتى وتجسد منكِ.

transliterations.english: Pi-estamnos ennoub: ere pimanna heep enkheetf: is Piloghos ente Efiot: i afchisarks enkheeti.

sung.english: The golden pot, where the manna was hidden, behold the Word of the Father, came and was incarnate of you.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲗⲩⲭⲛⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲉⲧϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁ Ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲁⲧϣ̀ϧⲱⲛⲧ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ.

translations.english: The golden lampstand, carrying the true Light, who is the unapproachable, Light of the world.
translations.arabic: المنارة الذهبية، الحاملة النور الحقيقي، الذي هو نور العالم، الذي لا يُدنى منه.

transliterations.english: Tilikhnia ennoub: etfai kha Piowoini emmee: ete Efowoini empikosmos: piateshkhont erof.

lines.coptic: Ϯϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲉⲧϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁ ⲡⲓϫⲉⲃⲥ ⲛ̀ⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ.

translations.english: The golden censer, carrying the live coal, and the chosen incense, with a rich aroma.
translations.arabic: المجمرة الذهبية، الحاملة جمر النار، والبخور المختار، العنبري.

transliterations.english: Tishouree ennoub: etfai kha pijevs enekrom: nem pi-estoinoufi etsotp: enaromata.

lines.coptic: Ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲃⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛⲉⲙ ϯϩ̀ⲣⲏⲣⲓ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ.

translations.english: The rod of Aaron, that blossomed, and the holy flower, of the incense.
translations.arabic: عصا هارون، التي أزهرت، والزهرة المقدسة، التي للبخور.

transliterations.english: Pi-eshvot ente A-aron: etaffiri evol: nem ti-ehreeri ethowab: ente pi-estoinoufi.

sung.english: The rod of Aaron, that blossomed, and the holy flower, of incense.

lines.coptic: Ⲛⲁⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲥⲟⲡ: ⲥⲉⲉⲣⲥⲩⲙⲙⲉⲛⲓⲛ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓϫⲓⲛⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣⲓ: ⲱ̀ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.

translations.english: All these together, direct us to, the miraculous Birth, O Virgin Mary.
translations.arabic: هذة جميعها معاً، تدُلنا على، ولادتك العجيبة، يا مريم العذراء.

transliterations.english: Nai teerou evsop: se-ersimmenin nan: empijinmisi eneshfeeri: o Maria Tiparthenos.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲙⲁϩⲙⲏⲧϥ̀ⲧⲟ:

translations.english: The Fourteenth Part:
translations.arabic: القطعة الرابعة عشر:

transliterations.english: Timahmeetefto:

sung.english: Fourteenth Part

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲕⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ: ⲱ̀ Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ ⲛ̀ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲥⲉⲗⲥⲱⲗⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: You decorated our souls, O Moses the prophet, by the honor of the tabernacle, which you have adorned.
translations.arabic: زينت نفوسنا، يا موسى النبي، بكرامة القبة، التي زينتها.

transliterations.english: Aksolsel ennenpsishee: o Mo-isees pi-eprofeetees: khen eptaio enti-eskeenee: etakselsols evol.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ ⲛ̀ϩⲟⲩⲓϯ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁ Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ ⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲭⲁⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.

translations.english: The first tabernacle, which Moses had made, was the place of the forgiveness, for the children of Israel.
translations.arabic: القبه الأولى، التي صنعها موسى، موضع مغفرة خطايا، بني إسرائيل.

transliterations.english: Ti-eskeenee enhouiti: eta Mo-isees thamios: enouma enkanovi evol: ente nensheeri empisraeel.

lines.coptic: Ⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ.

translations.english: He made it with glory, as commanded by the Lord, and according to the patterns, shown unto him.
translations.arabic: صنعها بمجد، كقول الرب، وكجميع المُثل، التي أعلمه بها.

transliterations.english: Afthamios khen o-oou: kata epsaji emepshois: nem kata nitipos teerou: etaftamof eroou.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲕⲓⲃⲱⲧⲟⲥ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉⲥⲗⲁⲗⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: There was an ark, in the tabernacle, overlaid with gold, from within and without.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، تابوت مصَّفح، بالذهب من داخل، ومن خارج.

transliterations.english: O-on oukivotos: kee khen ti-eskeenee: eslaleeout ennoub: sakhoun nem savol.

sung.english: There was an ark, in the tabernacle, overlaid with gold, within and without.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲗⲁⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ϩⲁⲛⲬⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲥⲉⲉⲣϧⲏⲓⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱϥ.

translations.english: There was a mercy seat, in the tabernacle, and the golden Cherubim, overshadowed it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، غطاء وكاروبا، ذهب، يظللان عليه.

transliterations.english: O-on o-ilasteerion: kee khen ti-eskeenee: hansherouvim ennoub: se-erkheeivi egof.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲙⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲛⲛⲁ ϩⲏⲡ: ⲛ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ.

translations.english: There was a golden pot, in the tabernacle, and a measure of the manna, was hidden in it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، قسط ذهبي، وكيل مَنَّ، مخفي فيه.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-estamnos ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: ere oushi emmanna heep: enekhree enkheetf.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲗⲩⲭⲛⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲃⲥ: ⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲥ.

translations.english: There was a golden lampstand, in the tabernacle, and the seven lamps, shone upon it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، منارة من ذهب، وسبعة سُرج، تضئ عليها.

transliterations.english: O-on oulikhnia ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: ere pishashf enkheevs: erowoini egos.

sung.english: There was a golden lampstand, in the tabernacle, and the seven lamps, shown upon it.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲕⲩⲛⲁⲙⲱⲛⲟⲛ: ⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲙⲏϯ.

translations.english: There was a golden censer, in the tabernacle, and the chosen aloe, was in its midst.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، مجمرة من ذهب، والعود المختار، في وسطها.

transliterations.english: O-on oushouree ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: ere pikinamonon: etsotp khen tesmeeti.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϩ̀ⲣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉⲩϣⲱⲗⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲁ ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.

translations.english: There was a flower of incense, in the tabernacle, inhaled by all, the house of Israel.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، زهرة بخور، يستنشق رائحتها، جميع آل بيت إسرائيل.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-ehreeri enestoinoufi: kee khen ti-eskeenee: evsholem eros teerou: enje na epee empisraeel.

sung.english: There was a flower of incense, in the tabernacle, smelled by all, the house of Israel.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϣ̀ⲃⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲭⲱⲣⲓⲥ ϭⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧ̀ⲥⲟ.

translations.english: There was the rod of Aaron, in the tabernacle, this which has blossomed, without planting or watering.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، عصا هرون، هذه التي أزهرت، بغير غرس ولا سقي.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-eshvot ente A-aron: kee khen ti-eskeenee: fai etaffiri evol: khoris cho nem etso.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲧ̀ⲣⲁⲡⲉⲍⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲡ̀ⲱⲓⲕ ⲛ̀ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲑⲉⲥⲓⲥ: ⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲥ.

translations.english: There was a golden table, in the tabernacle, and the oblation bread, was placed upon it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، مائدة ذهبية، وخبز التقدمة، موضوعاً عليها.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-etrapeza ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: epoik enti-eprostesis: kee e-ehree egos.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉϥⲉⲛ ϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ: ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ.

translations.english: There was a high priest, in the tabernacle, offering sacrifices, on account of the peoples sins.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، رئيس كهنة، يُصعد الذبائح، عن خطايا الشعب.

transliterations.english: O-on o-arshee-erevs: kee khen ti-eskeenee: efen shoushooushi e-epshoi: ejen ninovi ente pilaos.

sung.english: There was a high priest, in the tabernacle, offering sacrifices, on account of the people's sins.

lines.coptic: Ⲁϥϣⲁⲛϣⲱⲗⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ: ϣⲁϥⲱ̀ⲗⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ.

translations.english: When the Pantocrator, smelled the aroma, He lifted up the sins, of the people.
translations.arabic: إذا إشتم رائحتها، ضابط الكل، يرفع هنالك، خطايا الشعب.

transliterations.english: Afshansholem erof: enje Pipantokrator: shafoli emmav: enninovi ente pilaos.

sung.english: When the Almighty, smelled the aroma, He lifted up the sins, of the people.

lines.coptic: Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲱⲁⲕⲓⲙ: ⲁⲛⲥⲟⲩⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲭⲁⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: Through Mary, the daughter of Joachim, we learned of the true Sacrifice, for the forgiveness of sin.
translations.arabic: من قِبَل مريم، إبنة يواقيم، عرفنا الذبيحة الحقيقية، لمغفرة الخطايا.

transliterations.english: Evol hiten Maria: etsheri enyoakim: ansowen Pishoushooushi emmee: enkanovi evol.

sung.english: Through Mary, the daughter of Joachim, we learned of the true Sacrifice, for the forgiveness of sins.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲙⲁϩⲙⲏⲧϯ:

translations.english: The Fifteenth Part:
translations.arabic: القطعة الخامسة عشر:

transliterations.english: Timahmeetti:

sung.english: Fifteenth Part

lines.coptic: Ⲛⲓⲙ ⲡⲉⲑⲛⲁϣ̀ⲥⲁϫⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ ⲛ̀ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲥⲉⲗⲥⲱⲗⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ.

translations.english: Who can speak of, the honor of the tabernacle, which was decorated, by the prophet.
translations.arabic: من يقدر أن، يصف كرامة، القبة التي، زينها النبي.

transliterations.english: Nim pethna-eshsaji: emeptaio enti-eskeenee: etafselsols evol: enje pi-eprofeetees.

lines.coptic: Ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁϧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲅ̀ⲣⲁⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲁⲩϭⲓϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱ.

translations.english: When the chosen scholars, of the holy books, saw it, they were greatly amazed.
translations.arabic: لما رآها، المعلمون المختارون، للكتب المقدسة، تعجبوا جداً.

transliterations.english: Etavnav eros: enje nisotp ensakh: ente ni-eghrafee ethowab: avchi-eshfeeri emasho.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲙⲟⲕⲙⲉⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲟⲩⲕⲁϯ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲙ: ⲁⲩⲉⲣⲙⲏⲛⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲅ̀ⲣⲁⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.

translations.english: They thought, with their bright minds, and explained it, through the holy books.
translations.arabic: وفكروا، بفهمهم السامي، وفسَّروها، من الكتب المقدسة.

transliterations.english: Avmokmek evol: khen poukati etshom: avermeenevin emmos: khen ni-eghrafee ethowab.

sung.english: They thought with, their enlightened minds, and explained it, through the holy books.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲱⲁⲕⲓⲙ: ϫⲉ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲥⲁⲃⲁⲱⲑ.

translations.english: They called Mary, the daughter of Joachim, the true tabernacle, of the Lord of hosts.
translations.arabic: ودعوا مريم، إبنة يواقيم، القبة الحقيقية، التي لرب الجنود.

transliterations.english: Avmouti emaria: etsheri enyoakim: je ti-eskeenee emmee: ente Epshois savaoth.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ϯⲕⲓⲃⲱⲧⲟⲥ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉⲥⲕⲉⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ.

translations.english: They likened the ark, to the Virgin, and its chosen gold, to her purity.
translations.arabic: شبهوا التابوت، بالعذراء، وذهبه المختار، بطهارتها.

transliterations.english: Aven tikivotos: hijen Tiparthenos: peskenoub etsotp: hijen pestouvo.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲓ̀ⲗⲁⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲓⲥ Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲥⲉⲉⲣϧⲏⲓⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲥ.

translations.english: They likened the mercy seat, to the Virgin, and the Cherubim of glory, overshadowing her.
translations.arabic: شبهوا الغطاء، بالعذراء، وكاروبا المجد، يظللان عليها.

transliterations.english: Aven pilasteerion: hijen Tiparthenos: is Nisherouvim ente epoou: se-erkheeivi egos.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲙⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉϥⲕⲉϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲛⲛⲁ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.

translations.english: They likened the golden pot, to the Virgin, and the measure of the manna, to our Savior.
translations.arabic: شبهوا القسط الذهبي، بالعذراء، وكيلة المَنَّ، بمخلصنا.

transliterations.english: Aven pi-estamnos ennoub: hijen Tiparthenos: pefkeshi emmanna: hijen Pensoteer.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ϯⲗⲩⲭⲛⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲡⲉⲥⲕⲉϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲃⲥ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲅⲙⲁ.

translations.english: They likened the golden candlestand, to the Church, and the seven lamps, to its seven orders.
translations.arabic: شبهوا المنارة الذهبية، بالكنيسة، وسُرجها السبعة، بالسبع طغمات.

transliterations.english: Aven tilikhnia ennoub: hijen Tiekkleesia: peskeshashf enkheevs: hijen pishashf entaghma.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ϯϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉⲥⲕⲩⲛⲁⲙⲱⲛⲟⲛ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.

translations.english: They likened the golden censer, to the Virgin, and its aloes, to Emmanuel.
translations.arabic: شبهوا المجمرة الذهبية، بالعذراء، وعنبرها، بعمانوئيل.

transliterations.english: Aven tishouree ennoub: hijen Tiparthenos: peskinamonon: hijen Emmanoweel.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ϯϩ̀ⲣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ: ⲡⲉⲥⲕⲉⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲁ.

translations.english: They likened the flower of incense, to Mary the Queen, and the chosen incense, to her virginity.
translations.arabic: شبهوا زهرة البخور، بمريم الملكة، وبخورها المختار، ببتوليتها.

transliterations.english: Aven ti-ehreeri enestoinoufi: hijen Maria tiouro: peske-estoinoufi etsotp: hijen tesparthenia.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲃⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ϣⲉ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲉϣ Ⲡⲁϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.

translations.english: They likened the rod of Aaron, to the wood of the Cross, which my Lord was crucified upon, in order to save us.
translations.arabic: شبهوا عصا هرون، بخشبة الصليب، التي صُلب ربي عليها، حتى خلصنا.

transliterations.english: Aven pi-eshvot ente A-aron: hijen epshe ente Pi-estavros: etavesh Pashois erof: sha entefsoti emmon.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲁⲡⲉⲍⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉⲣϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ: ⲡ̀ⲱⲓⲕ ⲛ̀ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲑⲉⲥⲓⲥ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ⲡ̀ⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ.

translations.english: They likened the golden table, to the altar, and the oblation bread, to the Body of the Lord.
translations.arabic: شبهوا المائدة الذهبية، بالمذبح، وخبز التقدمة، بجسد الرب.

transliterations.english: Aven ti-etrapeza ennoub: hijen pima enershooushi: epoik enti-eprothesis: hijen Epsoma emepshois.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲩⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: Ⲡⲓϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲭⲁⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: They likened the high priest, to our Savior, the true Sacrifice, for the forgiveness of sins.
translations.arabic: شبهوا رئيس الكهنة، بمخلصنا، الذبيحة الحقيقية، لمغفرة الخطايا.

transliterations.english: Aven piarshee-erevs: hijen Pensoteer: Pishoushooushi emmee: enkanovi evol.

lines.coptic: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲉⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲑⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲉⲥϣⲏⲡ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ.

translations.english: He who offered Himself, as an acceptable sacrifice, upon the Cross, for the salvation of our race.
translations.arabic: هذا الذي أصعد ذاته، ذبيحة مقبولة، على الصليب، عن خلاص جنسنا.

transliterations.english: Fai etafenf e-epshoi: enouthisia essheep: hijen Pi-estavros: kha epougai empengenos.

lines.coptic: Ⲁϥϣⲱⲗⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲁ̀ⲣⲟⲩϩⲓ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ϯⲅⲟⲗⲅⲟⲑⲁ.

translations.english: His good Father, smelled Him, in the evening, on Golgotha.
translations.arabic: فإشتمه، أبوه الصالح، وقت المساء، على الجلجثة.

transliterations.english: Afsholem erof: enje Pefiot enaghathos: emefnav ente hanarouhi: hijen Tigholghotha.

sung.english: His good Father, smelled Him, in evening, on Golgotha.

lines.coptic: Ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲟ: ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲓⲥⲟⲥ: ⲁϥⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉϥⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲕⲉⲥⲟⲡ.

translations.english: He opened the gate, of Paradise, and restored Adam again, to his authority.
translations.arabic: فتح باب الفردوس، وردَّ آدم، إلى رئاسته، مرة أخرى.

transliterations.english: Afowon emefro: empiparathisos: aftasto enadam: etefarshee enkesop.

sung.english: He opened the gate, of Paradise, and restored Adam, to his authority.

lines.coptic: Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲱⲁⲕⲓⲙ: ⲁⲛⲥⲟⲩⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲭⲁⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: Through Mary, the daughter of Joachim, we learned of the true Sacrifice, for the forgiveness of sins.
translations.arabic: من قِبَل مريم، إبنة يواقيم، عرفنا الذبيحة الحقيقية، لمغفرة الخطايا.

transliterations.english: Evol hiten Maria: etsheri enyoakim: ansowen Pishoushooushi emmee: enkanovi evol.

lines.coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲧⲱⲃϩ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛϣⲁϣⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲛⲁⲓ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.

translations.english: And we too, hope to win mercy, through your intercessions, with the Lover of Mankind.
translations.arabic: ونحن أيضاً، نطلب أن نفوز برحمةٍ، بشفاعاتِك، عند محب البشر.

transliterations.english: Anon hon tentovh: ethrenshashni evnai: hiten ne-epresvia: entotf empimairomi.

sung.english: And we also pray, that we may win mercy, through your intercessions, with the Lover of Mankind.
